policy.commit: refuse when any staged path is outside the agent's owned_prefixes
policy.amend: refuse when ANY file in HEAD is outside the agent's owned_prefixes
policy.head_moved: refuse when HEAD changed between guard start and the actual commit
policy.unknown_agent: warn only - never block an agent that has not declared ownership
policy.escape_hatch: AGENT_GUARD_ALLOW=1 (logged loudly; use only for a reviewed exception)
